name: revinners/shopware6-jtl-connector-guard
description: Guards Shopware data against unwanted overwrites by the JTL-Connector (JTL-Wawi): customer number write protection, plus a same-person check that lets JTL-Wawi edit a customer but never write one customer onto another customer's account.

description.de-DE: Schützt Shopware-Kundendaten vor dem JTL-Connector: Kundennummer, sowie eine Gleiche-Person-Prüfung – JTL-Wawi darf Kunden bearbeiten, aber nie einen Kunden auf das Konto eines anderen schreiben.
description.en-GB: Protects Shopware customer data from the JTL-Connector: the customer number, plus a same-person check. JTL-Wawi may edit a customer but never write one customer onto another customer's account.
description.pl-PL: Chroni dane klientów Shopware przed JTL-Connectorem: numer klienta oraz kontrola tej samej osoby. JTL-Wawi może edytować klienta, ale nigdy nie nadpisze konta jednego klienta danymi innego.
